addons.name: Plex player
addons.author: HuskerMinion and kevin909867
addons.summary: Makes the device a player in Plex apps, so music and films cast from your Plex Media Server play on it.

versions.todo: TODO: v0.1.0's release carries no addon.json, so no manifest is pinned here and devices list this version without offering to install it. The addon.json on techo5-plex's addon-manifest branch (version 0.2.0) ships with its next release: add that release as a new version entry, pinning its binaries and its addon.json asset with mkcatalog -pin URL=FILE and checking the manifest with mkcatalog -manifest FILE, raise the serial, and sign (tools/sign-catalog.ps1).
